job.job_description:
Overview

We are seeking a skilled Back-End Developer to develop, maintain, and optimize server-side applications and systems. The ideal candidate should be strong in backend technologies, database management, API development, and writing scalable, secure code. Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain server-side logic and APIs.
Build and integrate RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
Design and optimize databases, schemas, and queries.
Ensure application performance, scalability, and security.
Collaborate with front-end developers and product teams to deliver complete solutions.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance existing backend systems.
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices.
Implement authentication, authorization, and security standards.
Work with cloud services or on-prem deployments as required.

Required Skills

Proficiency in backend programming languages such as:
Node.js, Java, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, or C#.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and OOP.
Experience with backend frameworks like Express.js, Spring Boot, Django, Laravel, .NET Core, etc.
Good knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
Experience with API design, REST standards, and authentication (JWT, OAuth).
Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
Understanding of caching, microservices, and server architecture is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional)

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Exposure to testing frameworks (Jest, JUnit, PyTest, etc.).
Understanding of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
